subject: The tree carries status drift that no check looks for
recordedOccasion: from a conformance sweep run at the owner's direction before any retrofit.
severity: F1 is high — an `unclaimed` bundle is meant to be closed to every session and one is not. F5 is high for a different reason: it is a defect in the instrument, and acting on the instrument's raw output would touch sixty-five records that are correct.
feltAt: `0001` F1; `0030`, `0035`, `0036`; eleven bundles resolved before Revision 162's conversion
scope: session management. The remedy is a check and a retrofit, and the retrofit waits on `docs/architecture/state-as-data.md`
read: every `findings.md`, `decisions.md`, `resolutions.md` and `STATUS-` tag in the four trees — 45 bundles, 131 findings
`docs/legend.md`, the ladder and the two permission tables

members.statement: Releasing a bundle to `unclaimed` leaves its findings where they were, so a bundle closed to every session holds a readable finding
members.sectionHeading: F1 — an `unclaimed` bundle holding a live finding

resolution.whatWasDone: `CLOSED-BUNDLE-LIVE-FINDING` removed; `unclaimed` joins the counted ordering exemptions. Revision 287 dissolved the premise, so this is a removal rather than a repair

members.statement: Six `accepted` decisions never moved their finding out of `framing`
members.sectionHeading: F2 — six decisions that moved nothing

resolution.whatWasDone: Nothing repaired. The six accepted decisions in `0001` could not have moved its F1: `decided` is the owner's act and `0001` has no owner

members.statement: Three bundles carry resolutions for findings that are not resolved
members.sectionHeading: F3 — resolutions for findings that are not resolved

members.statement: Eleven `resolved` bundles have no `decisions.md`, and whether they owe one has never been decided
members.sectionHeading: F4 — eleven resolved bundles with no `decisions.md`

members.statement: A conformance sweep that does not know about superseding clones reports sixty-five false positives
members.sectionHeading: F5 — the sweep is wrong before it is right

resolution.whatWasDone: Nothing, by decision. `is_clone()` exempted superseding clones from both ordering comparisons at Revision 231; the row records the revision that did the work, not the one that noticed

members.statement: A guard fails where a checker only reports, and the discipline that exists for checkers — a clean pass before it is trusted — has never been stated for guards
members.sectionHeading: F6 — the discipline exists for checkers and has never been stated for guards

resolution.whatWasDone: §6 gains the warn-only rule for anything that refuses a write, in both directions — shown not to fire on correct work and shown to fire on a case it should catch

members.statement: `plan_findings_work.py:439` treats `transferred` as `unclaimed` and reports a permitted transfer as a conformance failure, the last executable site of a rule the documents retired
members.sectionHeading: F7 — a check refuses an operation the instruction set permits

resolution.whatWasDone: `plan_findings_work.py` no longer reports a `transferred` bundle under `CLOSED-BUNDLE-LIVE-FINDING`; the `unclaimed` half stays and its detail names `0047` F1 as undecided

members.statement: `plan_findings_work.py` validates decision outcomes against a set the legend replaced: it accepts the two the legend retired and rejects five of the seven it defines, one of which three live decisions already use
members.sectionHeading: F8 — the outcome check enforces a vocabulary the legend replaced

resolution.whatWasDone: `OUTCOMES` is the legend's six bare values with `replaced` matched by prefix; the two retired prefixes are gone, and a contract test asserts the disjointness the legend has claimed since Revision 233

members.statement: The two ordering comparisons report eight rows against `superseded` bundles, which no session may write to, so the rows cannot be cleared by anyone
members.sectionHeading: F9 — the sweep reports rows that nobody is permitted to clear

resolution.whatWasDone: A `superseded` bundle is exempt from both ordering comparisons — 8 rows in `0031` and `0032` — and `check` counts both exemptions and names their bundles instead of asserting one in a footer

members.statement: The clone exemption is bundle-wide and never expires, so it suppresses the comparisons on a clone whose re-reading has closed — and the `reopened` status, which retains its resolution by design, is reported everywhere else
members.sectionHeading: F10 — the exemption has no expiry, and one status is exempted nowhere

resolution.whatWasDone: The clone exemption is per member and lapses when the member leaves `un-started`/`framing`; `reopened` is exempt from the resolution comparison in every bundle. Both comparisons move into one `ordering_hits()` read by the reporter and the counter

members.statement: The disjointness guard covered three of the five closed vocabularies, and the pair it did not cover was the broken one — while a session's `state` had no closed set and no vocabulary check at all
members.sectionHeading: F11 — the guard covered three vocabularies of five, and missed the broken pair

resolution.whatWasDone: `VOCABULARIES` and `DECLARED_OVERLAPS` replace three hand-listed comparisons with every pair of every closed set; `SESSION_STATES` is added and checked; the one unowned pair is excluded by name and asserted under `expectedFailure`

members.statement: A revision number can be taken in a commit message, which the helper that exists to prevent collisions cannot see
members.sectionHeading: F12 — a revision number can be taken where the helper cannot look

resolution.whatWasDone: `.share/check-manifest-revision.sh` scans the commit log as a third place; `bin/verify-manifest-coverage.sh` is new and reports MISSING, ORPHANED and DUPLICATE against the log, failing only on MISSING

decisions.decision: The migrated-bundle carve-out is restored to §3: a bundle migrated from an already-closed record carries `resolutions.md` and no `decisions.md`, and says so. This is `0037` D2, taken once and recorded in both bundles
decisions.sectionHeading: D1 — the ten owe nothing, and the rule says so again

decisions.decision: `transferred` leaves the closed-bundle assertion in `plan_findings_work.py` entirely; `unclaimed` keeps it, and its detail names `0047` F1 as the undecided rule the row rests on. The code name is unchanged
decisions.sectionHeading: D2 — a transfer is a permitted operation, so the check stops calling it a failure

decisions.decision: `OUTCOMES` becomes the legend's six bare outcomes with `replaced` matched by prefix; the two retired prefixes go; and a contract test asserts the disjointness `docs/legend.md` has claimed a schema check performs since Revision 233
decisions.sectionHeading: D3 — the outcome vocabulary becomes the legend's, and something asserts it

decisions.decision: F5 is recorded `resolved` against the work that already answered it — `is_clone()`, shipped at Revision 231 — rather than re-done; what the remedy did not cover is opened as F9 and F10 instead of being folded into the resolution
decisions.sectionHeading: D4 — a finding answered by work nobody recorded is resolved against that work

decisions.decision: The guard is rebuilt over a declared set of vocabularies rather than a hand-listed set of comparisons, and the one pair nobody here may fix is excluded by name rather than absorbed. `SESSION_STATES` is added and a session's stored `state` is checked against it
decisions.sectionHeading: D5 — the guard is driven by the sets it guards, and the exception is named

decisions.decision: The number helper consults the log as a third place and takes the highest of the three, because a number is taken if it is taken anywhere. Conformance is a different question and gets its own checker, `bin/verify-manifest-coverage.sh`
decisions.sectionHeading: D6 — the file and the log are two incomplete registers of one sequence

decisions.decision: The warn-only discipline goes into §6 as a gate on what may refuse a write, with the second half F6 did not have: a guard must be shown to fire on a case it should catch, not only to stay quiet on correct work
decisions.sectionHeading: D7 — a guard proves two things, and F6's sentence only asked for one

decisions.decision: A `superseded` bundle is exempt from both ordering comparisons, and `check` counts the suppression and names the bundles rather than asserting it in a footer
decisions.sectionHeading: D8 — a row nobody may clear is not reported, and the silence is counted

decisions.decision: The clone exemption becomes per member and expires with the re-reading window, keyed on the member's own status; and `reopened` is exempt from the resolution comparison in every bundle, because nothing is reverted when a member is reopened
decisions.sectionHeading: D9 — the exemption belongs to the member, and one half of it belongs to a status

decisions.decision: `CLOSED-BUNDLE-LIVE-FINDING` is removed entirely, both halves having been overtaken; and `unclaimed` joins `superseded` in the counted ordering exemptions, on the ground that nobody may perform the act that would clear the row
decisions.sectionHeading: D10 — the check outlived its question by one revision, and was written not to

edges.why: a bundle whose release left its findings behind, and a session whose work its state cannot show, are the same gap seen from either end
